objective: Predict the counterfactual normal-grasp absolute-bottom baseline from public empty approach motion before 1.253s, while retaining the latch-derived displaced-box signal only in the case absolute-bottom estimate.
feature: Fixed five-column linear reference: intercept, known mass, 1.22-1.25s vertical link tracking error, physics-fitted elastic-compliance coordinate over 1.18-1.25s, and initial 0.04-0.08s elastic spring-deflection norm. Public encoder/JTS and nominal reference/model only; no grip/latch pose, geometry label, force, seed, perturbation, or case ID.
fit: Twelve frozen passive torque normal public recordings n00-n11. Recompute the original sensor physics model and empty-reference regression inside each leave-one-normal-out fold. Fixed standardized ridge alpha 0.25; no feature/threshold selection after LOO or held truth.
uncertainty: 0.75mm finite geometry margin + maximum absolute revised leave-one-normal-out residual + largest five-block deletion change. Retain width<=2.5mm, sign-excluding interval, original mass/displacement/information domain, and unchanged strict/functional gates.

gates.strict: 8/8 vertical accepted correct sign, vertical point RMSE<=2mm, control max<=2mm, no accepted interval miss
gates.functional: 16-point RMSE<=2mm, max applied error<=2mm, no accepted interval miss, no action for |truth|<1mm, >=75% of |truth|>=2.5mm signed action with each error<=2mm
